coupling.opposingActions: Use net jawLeft-jawRight, mouthLeft-mouthRight and smile-frown on each side.
coupling.lipFamily: On each side, cap sum(upperUp,press,smile,frown,stretch) to 1.65 by proportional scaling.

limitations: Artist-derived preview shapes are not Genesis vertex geometry or calibrated Genesis deformation.
Per-action preview strength is bounded to 1 and jaw opening hinge to 12.6 degrees; DAZ export strength remains separately bounded by actual figure channels.
Original dental arches, oral cavity and bounded tongue added; no wrinkle displacement or identity conversion.
Tongue extension is an optional additional control, not a core Face Landmarker output.
Localized mouth patch uses ordered lip loops and small neutral surface smoothing; sparse morphs are anatomical approximations.
